Blunt Arrest.name: Blunt Arrest
Blunt Arrest.description: The user fires a broad calcium round that flattens on impact against one target within fifteen meters. It deals moderate bludgeoning damage without breaking skin and knocks the target down, giving allies until the end of the user's next turn to approach with restraints. Armor can absorb the impact; head shots remain dangerous and the shot adds barrel heat. Strain: moderate.
